response: A competent person in the context of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 of South Africa, refers to those who are appointed or selected by the Regulator for performing specific tasks and functions related to the regulation and management of personal information. This includes individuals like the Chairperson, members of the Regulator, and staff of the Regulator. These persons are accountable to the Regulator and must report their actions regularly as required by the regulator. They also have powers to exercise duties and functions conferred upon or assigned to them by the Regulator in order to maintain discipline among its staff and execute decisions made by the Regulator (section 14(d) of POPIA).
